messages:
maya: Escalating for Paylode — production embedding ingest started failing right after they flipped model to redwood-embed-v3-small. Indexer rejects with dim mismatch and the backfill queue exploded. Customer reports ~4.1k failed inserts and UI timeouts. Logs below.

sanjay: Can you paste the exact API request + indexer error? Also which model id they switched from/to?

maya: They said they switched from redwood-embed-v2 (1536 dim) -> redwood-embed-v3-small (768 dim) via Customer Console change at ~12:18Z. Repro payload:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v3-small","input":"hello world"}'
```
Response (short):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.0012,-0.0034,...],"index":0}],"model":"redwood-embed-v3-small"}
```
Indexer error: 
```text
[2024-11-05T12:23:45Z] ERROR InsertBatch failed: vector_dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=768 index=paylode_docs shard=3 cause="vector shape mismatch"
```

julia: Right — model switch changed embedding dimensionality. We should have validated that before allowing ingest. Is the indexer schema fixed to 1536?

ramon: Indexer (vecdb-prod) schema was created for Paylode with dim=1536 and is strict. Two paths: modify the index schema to accept variable dims (costly) or run a backfill to re-embed all documents with new model. Which does the customer want?

maya: Customer is panicking because search started returning garbage and billing spiked. They asked for a hotfix that doesn't require a full backfill.

leah: Immediate mitigations: (A) Revert Paylode to old model version if they still have access to it, (B) Stop the continuous ingest job and run a small patch that zero-pads 768->1536 before index insert (quick but lossy), (C) Queue a controlled backfill (preferred long term). Also file an internal incident.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-445 created and linked to ticket SUP-2345. Paging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

maya: Quick repro steps for eng: 1) call embeddings for model redwood-embed-v3-small -> confirm len(embedding)==768; 2) attempt insert to vecdb-prod using same client -> see "vector_dim_mismatch"; 3) run 1k parallel batches to reproduce throughput/latency spike: we saw indexer queue length jump and ~500-1200ms per insert latency.

julia: I'm going to open a small runtime change to add an `X-Embedding-Dim` header on the embeddings response so clients/indexer can short-circuit mismatch earlier. Also propose returning a top-level `metadata.dim` in the JSON. Will tag PR and link.

ramon: For the indexer side I'll add a frontend validation to reject writes earlier with a clearer error, and add a flag to accept padded vectors for backfill windows. Planning a controlled backfill job next week.

maya: Note: we saw billing doubled for Paylode because their client retried failed batches without dedupe; support asked for credit check. Finance notified.

leah: Action items: Maya — confirm whether Paylode can revert model (ASAP). Julia — PR for header + metadata. Ramon — indexer patch + backfill plan. Sanjay — coordinate support comms and billing credit convo. Update this thread when you have short status. :thumbsup:

maya: Update: Paylode rolled back to redwood-embed-v2 on their side at 12:42Z; ingest resumed but we still need post-mortem and better guards. I'll follow up with customer timeline.

ops-bot: SUP-2345 assigned to maya, priority=P1.

julia: PR opened: redwood/runtime#589 — adds X-Embedding-Dim + response metadata and a deprecation warning when model dims change.

ramon: Indexer change deployed to staging, will schedule prod rollout tomorrow during low traffic window. Backfill job template created and estimated time ~6 hours for Paylode dataset (~1.2M docs) with controlled concurrency.

leah: Thanks team. Please paste links to PRs/incidents in this thread so I can close the loop with the customer.

maya: Pasting links in follow-up message.
